name: Hidden Enemies
summary: In Orgrimmar, Thrall sends you to learn what the Burning Blade knows. Cult activity at Skull Rock has brought you to Neeru Fireblade with a lieutenant's insignia, to test his loyalties.

sections.title: The Warchief's Gambit
sections.body: Thrall chooses cunning over a strike at the Cleft of Shadow. He knows Neeru Fireblade pretends to serve the Horde while secretly aiding the cultists. A direct attack could warn Neeru's masters and end the trail into the conspiracy. So Thrall gives you an insignia taken from the cult in Durotar and asks you to pose as an initiate, learning what Neeru knows.

sections.title: The Cleft's Hidden Master
sections.body: Neeru Fireblade waits in the Cleft of Shadow, outside the entrance to Ragefire Chasm. He mistakes you for a newly promoted lieutenant and scorns Thrall's ignorance. Neeru says the Burning Blade and its offshoots, including the Searing Blade, answer to the Shadow Council, which serves the Burning Legion. He boasts that he manipulated Thrall into sending loyal soldiers against the cultists in the chasm, using the Warchief's forces to weed out the weak.

faq.q: Why does Thrall keep Neeru alive if he knows he is a traitor?
faq.answer: Thrall keeps Neeru alive so he can watch him. If Neeru were killed, the Shadow Council could replace him with someone harder to detect. Watched closely, Neeru may reveal the cult's movements in Orgrimmar without meaning to.

Neeru Fireblade is an orc warlock who lives in the Cleft of Shadow. He claims to help Thrall reform warlocks into dutiful servants of the Horde, but secretly leads the Burning Blade beneath the city for the Shadow Council.

faq.q: What is the relationship between the Burning Blade and the Shadow Council?
faq.answer: The Burning Blade is an arm of the Shadow Council, not an independent sect. The Council also controls cults such as the Searing Blade in Ragefire Chasm, dividing and misleading ambitious practitioners under the Burning Legion's rule.

faq.q: Who leads the cultists inside Ragefire Chasm?
faq.answer: Bazzalan, a satyr, and Jergosh the Invoker, an orc warlock, lead the Searing Blade in Ragefire Chasm. Neeru sends Thrall's adventurers against them to thin Horde loyalists and test his subordinates.

faq.q: How did I obtain the Lieutenant's Insignia?
faq.answer: You recovered the Lieutenant's Insignia during Thrall's first investigation of cult activity in Durotar. It came from Burning Blade cultists at Skull Rock.

angles.text: For the Horde, demonic cults beneath Orgrimmar's foundations threaten the young nation's survival.
As a warlock, you may see Neeru claiming a place for warlocks in the Horde. His treachery risks bringing severe condemnation on all who practice the fel arts under Thrall's rule.
As an orc, you know the Shadow Council's return beneath your capital echoes Draenor's dark past. Those who strive to escape bloodlust and demonic corruption carry that burden.
